title: Health Care Assistant Certificate
description: This certificate will equip the learners with the essential skills and knowledge required to provide quality care and support to patients in diverse healthcare settings.
longDescription: Learners will develop the ability to apply safe and ethical practices while assisting nurses and other medical professionals in delivering care. They will also demonstrate effective communication techniques to interact with patients, families, and healthcare teams. This programme aims to build confidence in handling basic clinical tasks and administrative responsibilities. It prepares learners to contribute efficiently to patient-centered care and enhance overall healthcare service delivery. The course will commence in the first week of November.
courseDetails: Explain the role and responsibilities of a healthcare assistant. Understand patient rights and confidentiality in healthcare. Apply basic infection control practices. Demonstrate patient hygiene and comfort care techniques. Recognize the importance of teamwork in patient care. Identify different healthcare settings and their requirements. Understand the principles of patient-centered care. Apply safe patient handling and mobility techniques. Demonstrate feeding and nutrition support for patients. Recognize signs of patient distress and report appropriately. Provide emotional and psychological support to patients. Maintain accurate documentation of care provided. Explain the principles of infection prevention and control. Demonstrate proper hand hygiene and use of PPE. Apply standard precautions during care delivery. Understand basic first aid techniques for minor injuries. Recognize emergency situations and respond effectively. Maintain a safe and clean care environment. Understand the importance of clear communication in healthcare. Apply effective communication techniques with patients and families. Demonstrate active listening and empathy in patient interactions. Collaborate effectively with nurses and healthcare teams. Recognize barriers to communication and overcome them. Maintain professional behavior in challenging situations. Understand ethical principles guiding health care assistance. Apply patient rights including dignity and informed consent. Demonstrate respect for cultural and individual differences. Recognize legal responsibilities of healthcare assistants. Maintain confidentiality in patient care. Apply professional standards in healthcare practice. The Health Care Assistant Certificate prepares learners with the foundational knowledge and practical skills required to support patients and healthcare teams in various care environments. The program emphasizes patient hygiene, nutrition assistance, mobility support, communication skills, and infection control practices. Learners will also understand ethical and cultural considerations in patient care, demonstrate professionalism, and apply safety protocols in clinical practice. By the end of the course, graduates will be able to provide compassionate, effective, and person-centered support in hospitals, clinics, long-term care, and community health settings. After the successful completion of this course, you will be able to: Unit 1: Introduction to Health Care Assistance Learning Outcomes: Unit 2: Patient Care and Support Services Unit 3: Infection Control and Basic First Aid Unit 4: Communication and Teamwork in Healthcare Unit 5: Ethical and Legal Considerations in Health Care Assistance

modules.title: Health Care Assistant Certificate
modules.summary: The Health Care Assistant Certificate prepares students to deliver safe, compassionate, and effective care to patients in hospitals, long-term care facilities, and community settings. The program focuses on assisting with daily living activities, personal hygiene, nutrition, and mobility support. Learners develop skills in infection prevention, communication, and patient-centered care. Training also emphasizes recognizing patient needs, supporting emotional well-being, and maintaining dignity and respect. Clinical and practical sessions ensure hands-on experience in healthcare environments. Graduates are ready to support nurses and other healthcare professionals in promoting quality patient care.
